artworks.title: The Virgin and Child with the Monkey
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 19.1 x 12.3 cm (7 1/2 x 4 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: Printed with fine black lines and velvety black shading on off-white paper, a woman, baby, and monkey sit in a landscape with a body of water and a house on the far bank in this vertical engraving. In the center of the composition, the woman sits with her knees angled slightly to our right, but she turns to look down at the baby, held at her other hip. She has hooded eyes, a straight, thin nose, thin lips, and a rounded, narrow chin. Long wavy hair falls behind her shoulders, and her dress has a square neckline and voluminous sleeves and skirt. The sleeve of her left arm, to our right, is pushed up to the elbow, and that hand rests on the spin of a book. The nude child leans into her other hand, looking at a bird he holds by the legs. The child has short, curly hair, round cheeks, and a pudgy body. With his other hand, he holds up a small sack pierced with holes to the bird, which flaps its wings wide. The monkey crouches at the woman’s right foot, to our left, and comes almost to her knee. The animal’s eyes slant dramatically up at the outer corners, and a blaze of fur surrounds its face. It is tied around the middle and tethered to an iron ring affixed to a low, wooden, garden wall. The woman and child sit in the corner of the wall, which continues toward us to the right. Sailboats dot the water, which leads back to a tiny, distant town and mountains on the horizon. In the top third of the print, puffy and screens of clouds span the sky. The artist signed the print with his initials, an uppercase “D” tucked between the long legs of an uppercase “A” in the lower center.

artworks.title: Nemesis (The Great Fortune)
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 33.4 x 23 cm (13 1/8 x 9 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged figure standing on a sphere above a landscape. The figure appears to be a nude, female-like form with large wings and a flowing ribbon-like cloth draped around her body. She holds a cup or chalice in one hand and stands atop a smooth orb, balancing above a detailed scene below. The landscape beneath her is meticulously detailed, depicting a medieval town with a river winding through it, nestled among rolling hills and rocky cliffs. Each building and tree is rendered with intricate lines, showcasing an expansive view that gives a sense of depth and perspective.

artworks.title: Harbor Scene with Rising Sun (Le soleil levant)
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image displays a coastal scene featuring ancient ruins and maritime activities. Large architectural ruins with columns are on the left, with figures performing tasks nearby. A horse is harnessed to a cart, and small boats are being managed by sailors to the right. Larger ships are anchored in the distance near a fortified coastline with towers. The horizon is indicated by the waterline just above the ships. The sketch-like composition includes detailed cross-hatching and fine lines for texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of brown, creating an antiquated feel.

artworks.title: The Herd Returning in Stormy Weather (Le troupeau en marche par un temps orageux)
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a landscape with a slightly elevated view. On the left are detailed columns resembling remnants of a structure. On the right, a figure tends to cattle and goats. The horizon is in the upper third of the image, showing hills, mountains, trees, and a distant fortification. The sky has clouds, depicted with fine line work typical of etchings. The color scheme is monochromatic with earthy browns and sepias.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray and blue wash and graphite, heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a landscape seen from a slightly elevated viewpoint. The horizon is low, with hills fading into the distance, enhancing the sense of depth. Trees with delicate branches frame the scene. The brushstrokes are fine and controlled, contributing to a dreamy quality. The color scheme is primarily soft blues and grays. A group of figures is seated on a knoll in the foreground, blending into the serene surroundings. The overall scene captures a tranquil moment with a harmonious use of color and form.

artworks.title: Tourelle de la Rue de la Tixéranderie, Paris (House with a Turret, Weavers' Street, Paris)
artworks.medium: etching on green laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an architectural street scene captured from a straight-on perspective. The focus is on the intricate design of the buildings, with a prominent conical tower in the center. Various rooftops with smokestacks emitting smoke are visible. The artwork is detailed in an etching style with a monochromatic sepia color palette. Small human figures are shown near us, some standing and others moving along a cobbled street, adding scale and activity to the scene.

artworks.title: La Pompe Notre-Dame, Paris (The Notre-Dame Pump)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on green laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a complex structure on wooden stilts over a river. On the left, there is a tower rising above the building complex with slanted roofs. The scene is filled with buildings extending into the distance, with no clear horizon visible. The etching features fine, detailed brushstrokes emphasizing intricate linework capturing textures of stone, wood, and water. The image has a monochromatic palette of sepia tones. Other buildings are densely packed beyond the structures on stilts, including one resembling a cathedral or significant architectural landmark. The water reflects the structures, and a few small boats with figures are visible.

artworks.title: Le stryge (The Vampire)
artworks.medium: etching on green laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape view from a high vantage point. A stone gargoyle is perched on the edge of a building, appearing as if it is looking over the city with its chin resting on its hand. The city features detailed buildings and rooftops, with a tall Gothic-style tower in the distance. Birds are flying around, adding movement to the scene. The artwork has intricate linework and a monochrome color palette, emphasizing contrast between light and shadow to enhance the three-dimensional effect of the structures and the gargoyle.

artworks.title: Saint-Etienne-du-Mont, Paris (Church of St. Stephen of the Mount, Paris)
artworks.medium: etching on green laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching of an urban architectural scene viewed from a slightly elevated position, showing a street leading to a church. The large church building features a rose window at its center and a tall bell tower. Buildings flank the view, with one showing aged brickwork and arched windows, and the other having scaffolding and workmen. The precise lines capture intricate details, creating depth and texture. The monochromatic color palette uses sepia tones, enhancing the historical feel. In the distance, figures and activities are subtly depicted.

artworks.title: La morgue, Paris (The Mortuary)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an urban scene near a waterway. A dockside area with people, boats, and buildings is depicted in intricate detail. The skyline is dominated by tall buildings emitting smoke. The illustration features fine etching and a monochromatic sepia color palette. People are seen on an elevated level observing the scene below, with multi-storied buildings in the background.

artworks.title: Le Pont-Neuf, Paris
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on green laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a bridge extending diagonally from the right to the left. Underneath the bridge, there is a river with a wooden structure and small boats. In the distance, there are tall buildings with smoke coming from chimneys, creating a busy urban atmosphere. The artwork appears to be an etching with detailed line work and cross-hatching to define shadows and textures. The color scheme is monochromatic with sepia tones. Distant buildings and silhouetted birds are also visible.

artworks.title: Ancienne habitation à Bourges, dite "La Maison du Musicien" (An Old House at Bourges, Sometimes Called the "Musician's House")
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on green laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an angled perspective of a street scene with rustic, half-timbered buildings stretching into the distance on the right. The horizon line is not distinctly visible, as the focus is on the detailed architecture and lively atmosphere. The etching technique creates fine, linear brushstrokes that convey texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, in varying shades of sepia. Figures are seen conversing near scattered barrels, while rooftops and chimneys lead the eye toward the background.

artworks.title: La Tour de l'Horloge, Paris (The Clock Tower, Paris)
artworks.medium: etching on green laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a cityscape with various buildings and a bridge crossing a river. The architecture features a tower-like structure, multiple spires, and a weather vane. The depiction is detailed with fine lines, suggesting an engraving technique. The color scheme is monochromatic, employing shades of black, white, and gray. Near the viewer, a bridge with arches spans the river, where a small boat is visible. In the distance, more tall buildings are seen. Smoke rises from chimneys, adding to the liveliness of the scene.

artworks.title: Le Petit Pont, Paris
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on green laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a streetscape with a cathedral in the distance. The etching features detailed architecture, including a river with a stone embankment. Rows of narrow buildings lead towards the cathedral, with a cloudy sky above. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing the contrast in the image.

artworks.title: L'arche du Pont Notre-Dame, Paris (An Arch of the Notre-Dame Bridge, Paris)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on green laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene under a large bridge. The perspective emphasizes the bridge and another distant bridge with architectural structures. The art style appears to be an etching with fine line work and hatching for texture. The color scheme is monochromatic in shades of brown and dark sepia, typical of etched prints. Small boats are docked by the bridge with figures, adding activity to the scene. In the sky, there are clouds and a few birds.

artworks.title: Le Pont-au-Change, Paris
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows buildings with multiple spire-topped towers on the right side of the river. The buildings are connected to the left side of the frame by a bridge that sits slightly below the horizon. In the sky, there are fluffy clouds and a drifting hot air balloon. The bridge's arches reflect on the water below, where small boats are present. The artwork is in an etching style with fine lines and stippling for texture. The color palette is monochrome in shades of sepia and brown, giving the image a historic quality.

artworks.title: La galerie Notre-Dame, Paris (The Gallery of Notre Dame, Paris)
artworks.medium: etching on green laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the interior of a gothic cathedral with detailed columns and arches. Through the arches, a city skyline with buildings, spires, and rooftops is visible. The intricate architectural elements such as columns and arches are etched with sharp lines. The monochromatic palette uses dark tones and shadows to create depth and contrast. Light and shadow play across the stonework, highlighting the carvings.

artworks.title: L'abside de Notre-Dame de Paris (The Apse of the Cathedral of Notre Dame, Paris)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a riverside scene with a large Gothic cathedral, human figures, a horse-drawn cart, boats, a stone bridge, and buildings. The cathedral is prominently featured slightly to the right of the center, with the point of view from a riverbank looking across the water. The horizon is aligned with the line of buildings and the cathedral's base, and the etching style consists of fine, intricate lines to define architectural features and figures with a monochrome color palette of sepia shades. The clouds above are detailed.

artworks.title: The Windmill
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a windmill on the left side. The horizon is low, with the sky appearing vast. There are structures near the windmill leading towards the horizon. The windmill and buildings are detailed with an etching technique. The color palette is earthy, possibly monochrome, emphasizing light and shadow contrast. Textures are depicted on the windmill and roofs, contributing to the realism of the composition.

artworks.title: The Three Trees
artworks.medium: etching, with drypoint and burin, on toned laid paper
artworks.description: Printed with deep, black shadows and swirling or straight lines on yellowed paper, three trees stand on a grassy bank alongside a body of water, probably a river or canal, in this horizontal etching, engraving, and drypoint. The grassy bank reaches almost two-thirds of the way across the composition from the right edge. At least two people, a horse-drawn wagon or carriage filled with more people, and a town, all minuscule in scale, are tucked under or beyond the trees. The face of the bank directly opposite us is dark in shadow and the details of plants and the waterline are hard to make out. The bank tapers down so the distant horizon, which comes about a third of the way up the composition, stretches across the left half of the print. One person sits and one stands, fishing, by the water in the lower left corner. People work and cows stand or lie in the flat field beyond the water, and buildings and windmills created with a few strokes of the burin or etching needle are tiny in the far distance. The deeply shaded three trees are outlined starkly against the white sky. Dark clouds pour across the top of the sheet and enter along the left edge, and diagonal lines across the top left corner suggests falling rain. The artist signed and dated the print among grasses in the lower left corner of the printed image: “Rembrandt f. 1643.”

artworks.title: Faust
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and engraving on rough beige paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 21.2 x 16.2 cm (8 3/8 x 6 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a figure leaning forward with one hand on a table, looking toward a bright light source from a window with intricate pane patterns. The person has an elderly appearance, wearing a turban or headscarf, and a long, textured garment. They hold a compass in their hand. The background features shelves, a figure or bust in shadows, and a circular emblem with Latin text, surrounded by books and scholarly items.

artworks.title: Ephraim Bonus
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and burin
artworks.description: The image shows a person leaning against a balustrade. The individual is slightly to the right, facing the viewer, with one hand on the railing. They have a beard and mustache, and wear a wide-brimmed hat and formal attire. The background features simple architecture with vertical and horizontal lines, including a stair railing in the foreground and a dark, textured backdrop.

artworks.title: Jan Lutma
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 19.8 x 15 cm (7 13/16 x 5 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting in a high-backed chair. He is holding a scroll and has a small hat on his head. The man wears a dark robe with a light inner layer at the neck, and there are objects on a table beside him. The background is a simple, lightly sketched surface.

artworks.title: Clement de Jonghe
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and burin on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seated individual in a frontal view, with their body captured from the waist up. The person is positioned with their arms resting casually, and their gaze is directed forward. Their facial features are finely detailed, with a composed expression, and they have medium-length hair partly hidden beneath a large, wide-brimmed hat. The hat's shadow creates a distinct outline on their face. They are wearing a coat or cloak, buttoned down the front, over a collared garment. This attire is characterized by folds and textures suggesting a dense fabric. The background of the image is a simple, shaded area with no additional elements or scenery.
